\newcommand{\CalibrationSentence}{Calibrating the shifts only on residuals of sessions completed before the month of each arrival, as an operator could, changes the flexibility retained at 2\,\% undelivered energy by at most 1.2 percentage points and changes the loss at a cold start by up to 4.6 percentage points, so that a cold start still removes at least 28\,\% of the flexibility (on the sessions both versions can score, ACN: 45.2\,\% against 44.6\,\%; Palo Alto: 28.3\,\% against 32.9\,\% with residuals from all periods; Supplementary Table \siref{tab:s-calibration}).}
